notes.title: IT'S SALES TIME + MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Winter Sale is here - time to drain your wallets![/h2]

[previewyoutube=K7L-c0zX26I;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32940668/450a683b0f825cde8250d05b89824077c455b16b.png[/img]


[h2]We've also worked on some QoL improvements and bug fixes![/h2]


[list]
[*] ✅Fixed - The NPC characters fail to reply even after being online in the chat restricting the player to progress in the game.
[*] ✅Fixed - The player is able to switch the tab after opening the keyboard from comment section in the 'Atlas' app.
[*] ✅Fixed - Two icons are highlighted when the player spams the Confirm button twice on a map location when using a controller in the 'Atlas' application.
[*] ✅Fixed - The text messages overlap when the player opens and exits an active chat when using a controller continuously in the 'Chat' application.
[*] ✅Fixed - The highlighter disappears when the player spams the 'Confirm' button on the Settings options.
[*] ✅Fixed - The highlighter disappears when the player selects the 'Exit to Main Menu' option during an active chat.
[*] ✅Fixed - While using a controller after scanning Paul's photo the image stays on top and cannot be closed.
[*] ✅Fixed - The player is able to perform the scan function anywhere after opening a file that is required to scan.
[*] ✅Fixed - The borders and background disappears when the player returns to Home screen directly while a video is being played.
[*] ✅Fixed - The highlighter moves to an incorrect position on pressing Left D-pad button after uploading an incorrect file in Atlas.
[*] ✅Fixed - The save data fails to reset when the player changes the language from the 'Settings' option.
[*] ✅Fixed - The subtitle keeps displayed rolling even after the recording is paused during the gameplay.
[*] ✅Fixed - The scroll function fails to work when the 'Home' icon is selected after opening Amy's website from the 'Phone' application.
[*] ✅Fixed - The legend icons change to normal in 'Tracing Mode' after performing certain steps with the controller.
[*] ✅Fixed - The subtitles are missing during a call with the Receptionist
[*] ✅Fixed - The player is able to access the background options after invoking the objective screen using controller.
[*] ✅Fixed - The scan icon truncates with the navigation buttons for the audio file during a chat with Ruby.
[*] ✅Fixed - App Notification Badges fail to load after loading the saved game.
[*] ✅Fixed - Button depictions for Xbox and PS4 controller are missing for Unlock mode and Tracing mode while accessing the Atlas.
[*] ✅Fixed - The player is unable to scroll through the image after spamming the 'Confirm' button for a while when using a controller.
[*] ✅Fixed - Navigation buttons and status bar disappears when the player presses the 'Home' button after zooming into an image using a controller.
[*] ✅Fixed - Home button closes the keyboard in the comment section of any post in the Feed tab.
[*] ✅Fixed - Text error is observed during a conversation with 'Ruby' while guiding 'Ruby' out of Paul's house.
[*] ✅Fixed - The title gets stuck during the video call with Ruby which leads to the progression blocker.
[*] ✅Fixed - Title crashes during the chat with Ruby while investigating Thomas's whereabouts.
[*] ✅Fixed - The messages get tilt after playing the Mistress of the Night video in Thomas chat.
[*] ✅Fixed - Special character is displayed in the text description of the achievement 'Welcome to Stonecreek'.
[*] ✅Fixed - The messages disappear as the player scrolls any chat upward in Chats application.
[*] ✅Fixed - The main menu is not localized after changing the language to Chinese.
[*] ✅Fixed - Warehouse attachment shows in the Dialogue option after it is sent during the chat with Ruby in Chat app.
[*] ✅Fixed - Exit to main menu confirmation pop failed to display when the player press 'ESC' on the objective screen.
[*] ✅Fixed - The game crashes when the player selects the Cancel option on the Exit confirmation pop-up and force close the game using ALT+F4.
[*] ✅Fixed - The dialogue options for Ruby's chat are displayed incorrectly when trying to contact Persephone.
[*] ✅Fixed - The 'LET' option fails to respond by using the mouse during the interactive cutscene.
[/list]

notes.title: BUG Fixes & QoL Updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Notes straight out of Stonecreek![/h2]




[list]
[*] ✅FIXED - Layout of Paul's home on the Vanguard app is incorrect with respect to Ruby's Movement.
[*] ✅FIXED - The player can invoke applications listed on top of the objective screen while a cutscene is being displayed.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The player is unable to move the highlighter to any specific room when using a controller from the 'Vanguard' application.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The 'Skip' option fails to function while using a controller when the 'Credits' are being displayed after ending the game
[*] ✅FIXED -  The multiple UI issues are noted after sending order twice from the Order menu.
[*] ✅FIXED -  Background and borders disappears and all the controls fails to function if the 'Option' button is spammed.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The game fails to take input from multiple button when the player directly jumps from one application to another via Menu option.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The highlighter disappears when navigating down from File present in the last row using a Controller
[*] ✅FIXED -  The pop-up for 'Unlock Mode' & 'Tracing Mode' displays on the 'Notes' tab if quickly switched after spamming the desired controls while using a controller.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The Back button fails to function after opening and closing any file from Notes tab.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The pattern cannot be entered in succession after entering an invalid pattern.
[*] ✅FIXED -  Paul's blog cannot be opened from the 'Chat' or 'Surfer' application when using a controller.
[*] ✅FIXED -  The player is unable surf through the 'Map' in 'Tracing Mode' after selecting one location in the Atlas application.
[/list]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925970/SIMULACRA_3/
